Position: Software Developer
 Location: Sunnyvale, CA
 Duration: 18 Months +
 Rate: Open
 

 ****This is an immediate need, and this role will last for about 18 to 24 months. The manager wants to speak with candidates before this week is out. 
 

 Performs inspections and sets quality assurance testing models for analysis of raw materials, materials in process, and finished products. Requires a bachelor's degree and 0-2 years of experience in the field or in a related area. Has knowledge of commonly-used concepts, practices, and procedures within a particular field. Relies on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Works under immediate supervision. Primary job functions do not typically require exercising independent judgment. Typically reports to a supervisor or manager.  
 

 Position Comments:
 This Smart Internet position for TQM requires a candidate with experience in Software and System Integration with ability to debug and troubleshoot through logging and end to end testing functionality. The candidate must be well versed in software tools and able to create and/or modify code in order to perform the function of integrating software, compile and release code for downstream testing activities prior to large scale deployment. Software development skills and experience will be a strong plus for this position. Defect tracking, management and overall lifecycle oversight to resolution and closure will be a key expectation for this role.
 1. Be verse in CPE/STB technology. 
 2. Be able to compile code.
 3. Be experienced with C/C++/Java/Python and other interpreted languages.
 4. Be familiar with mobile app development.
 5. Be very knowledgable with networking including wifi (SoftGRE and FastGRE) 6. Be able to work in a fast paced eveniorment.
 7. Be open to travel, limited.
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
